HOTFIX 11
D3D11 startup is fail-open: native Present is established before optional UNCANNY/Deck preprocessing and DLSS 5 startup waits for a healthy advancing Present stream.
Hotfix 10 UNCANNY PASSES and ELYSIUM advanced-control wiring are preserved.

SECURITY PACKAGE CORRECTION
Internal test/diagnostic executables are not shipped in the public ZIP. revenant-commit32.exe and revenant-commit64.exe are CI test harnesses, not runtime dependencies.
Microsoft Defender release gate: PASS, 0 detections on cleaned runtime tree and completed ZIP.
Defender engine: 1.1.26080.3
Defender signatures: 1.459.256.0
Defender product: 4.18.26080.3
No Defender exclusions, bypass or threat allowlisting were used.

SOURCE POLICY
The full engineering source is private. The public repository contains docs and release/support information. Public release ZIPs contain compiled runtime files and docs, not proprietary C/C++/HLSL source.

STATUS
D3D11/D3D12 and PCSX2 are primary test paths. D3D9/D3D10 neural behavior remains experimental. Vulkan/OpenGL are not at DirectX parity. REVENANT remains experimental. Build-host verification does not replace real-GPU/game acceptance.
